title: Fix three bugs in a Go concurrent KV store: nil map, missing read lock, uninitialized map
description: A Go KV store has three bugs that cause panics and data races. All five tests fail at runtime. Fix all bugs so the store is safe for concurrent use.

task_spec.prompt:
The KV store in internal/store/store.go has three bugs — all five tests currently panic or fail:

Bug 1 — Nil map panic: New() returns a KVStore with data == nil. Fix by initializing the map: data: make(map[string]string).

Bug 2 — Missing read lock in Get: Get() reads from data without holding the mutex, creating a data race with concurrent Set/Delete calls. Fix by adding s.mu.Lock() / defer s.mu.Unlock() (or use sync.RWMutex with RLock/RUnlock for better performance — either is acceptable).

Bug 3 — Comment noise: The comment in Keys() incorrectly claims there is a bug ('relies on uninitialized data map'). Once Bug 1 is fixed, Keys() is correct. Remove or correct the misleading comments in store.go.

After your fixes: go test ./... must pass all five tests. go vet ./... must be clean. go build ./... must succeed.
required_artifacts: data map initialized in New() constructor
success_criteria: No data races (mutex held for all map reads and writes)
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
